Tomato_Late_blight.description: A fungal-like disease that causes dark patches and leaf decay, spreads fast in cool and wet weather.
Tomato_Late_blight.symptoms: Brown/black lesions, white mold under leaves, rapid leaf death.
Tomato_Late_blight.prevention: Avoid overhead watering, ensure spacing, remove infected leaves.

Tomato_Early_blight.description: Fungal disease causing concentric ring spots, common in warm humid conditions.
Tomato_Early_blight.symptoms: Target-like rings, yellowing leaves, reduced yield.
Tomato_Early_blight.prevention: Crop rotation, remove infected debris, fungicide if needed.

Tomato_healthy.prevention: Maintain good watering, nutrition and pest control.
